finding: The existing native EDIT superclass route recognizes the actual USER instance type independently of the registered name; no production-source change is established by this model.
fixture: Self-owned C registers TMemo and TMaskEdit names over native EDIT. Both widths at 96/144 DPI check native superclass identity, multi-line replacement/undo, read-only setting, scroll position, font preservation and styled-to-detached print pixels.

package.publish: assets root and O:/winnt/system32, tested four-file hashes matched

limitations: TMaskEdit is only a plain EDIT superclass model: mask formatting, validation, input and real Delphi behavior are not verified. The read-only check verifies setting and unchanged text, not an attempted edit. TRichEdit is a distinct implementation and is not covered. Actual Delphi applications and physical input remain for T18 final integration.
